placements.title: Owning the perspective when the substrate is a commodity
placements.frame: What does it mean to own rather than rent intelligence, and where does durable value sit once the substrate becomes interchangeable?
placements.why: src-2 and src-3 perform a thematic contrast between owned and rented intelligence, locating durable value in perspective rather than substrate. This names a directional subject future envelopes could feed — the individually-owned-intelligence thesis — not a one-time fact. The graph and strata are both empty, so this is a standalone mint with no existing hub or category to attach under.
